sassa_gold_card.value: SASSA Gold Card — phased out. Gold Cards stopped working on 31 August 2026. Grant payments still go into the beneficiary's account each month, but the funds can only be accessed with a Postbank Black Card.
sassa_gold_card.verified_by: Postbank via gov.za media statement; EWN (31 Aug 2026); IOL (24 Aug 2026)

postbank_black_card.value: Postbank Black Card — required replacement for the phased-out SASSA Gold Card. Free, works immediately, no SASSA office visit or forms needed, and the Gold Card balance carries over automatically. Available at Shoprite, Checkers, Usave, Pick n Pay, Boxer and Spar sites, which remained open after the 31 August 2026 deadline. Locate a site with *120*355#.
postbank_black_card.verified_by: Postbank via gov.za, EWN (31 Aug 2026), IOL (24 Aug 2026)

card_replacement_cost.value: Free of charge, including after the 31 August 2026 deadline. Bring a valid South African ID or temporary ID to a Postbank service point (Shoprite, Checkers, Usave, Pick n Pay, Boxer or Spar). If anyone demands payment, it is a scam.
card_replacement_cost.verified_by: Postbank CCO Thami Cele via EWN (31 Aug 2026); gov.za media statement

postbank_site_locator_ussd.note: Postbank USSD store locator for identifying the nearest card replacement site.

sassa_whatsapp_number.note: SASSA Self-Service WhatsApp (Social Grants). Flow: send 'Hi' → Social Grants → grant type → verify with mobile number, OTP and ID → Application Status / 'Am I in Review?' / proof-of-life checks. Launched August 2026; confirmed in the SASSA digital-services briefing of 18 September 2026.
sassa_whatsapp_number.verified_by: Official sassa.gov.za WhatsApp channel link; IOL (26 Aug 2026), EWN (4 Aug 2026), The Citizen (1 Sep 2026)

sassa_whatsapp_srd_number.note: Older SRD WhatsApp/status line, still active. Both 082 601 0111 and 082 046 8553 are official SASSA WhatsApp channels.

sassa_review_status_whatsapp.note: Proof-of-life and review-status check available through the SASSA Self-Service WhatsApp (082 601 0111) inside the Social Grants flow. Confirmed in SASSA digital-services briefing coverage.
sassa_review_status_whatsapp.verified_by: Citizen / JoburgETC coverage of the SASSA digital-services briefing, 18 September 2026

sassa_helpline.note: Toll-free SASSA helpline. Calls are free from any phone.

ussd_postbank_balance.note: Postbank USSD code for SASSA grant balance/status on a Postbank account or SASSA card holder account.

ussd_srd_legacy.note: Older SRD USSD application/status code. Largely deprecated — use *120*69277# for status or the portal for applications. Verify with your network before relying on it.

srd_sca_status.note: The Supreme Court of Appeal heard SASSA's appeal on 25 August 2026 and reserved judgment. The High Court findings (online-only application, R624 threshold and R370 amount unconstitutional; in-person applications, progressive increases, once-off gifts excluded from income) are not in force pending the SCA decision. The SRD amount and income limit remain unchanged until a court order is implemented.
srd_sca_status.verified_by: Daily Maverick, GroundUp, TimesLIVE, The South African, bizcommunity (25-28 Aug 2026)

srd_sept_2026_payment_window.note: SASSA has confirmed the COVID-19 SRD payment dates for September 2026: Wednesday 23 September and Friday 25 September. Beneficiaries are paid in a batch on either date depending on their 'Pay Day' date on the official SRD portal; they are not paid on both dates.
srd_sept_2026_payment_window.verified_by: SASSA official September 2026 SRD payment dates graphic
